prompt: Draw a clean, straight-on illustration of a station clock display displaying 7 round analog wall clocks arranged in a grid, each clock with clear hour and minute hands. IMPORTANT RULE: EVERY clock in this display is stopped at exactly the SAME time -- 6 o'clock. For every single clock, set the hands to 6:00 (the short hour hand pointing at 6 and the long minute hand pointing straight up at 12). All 7 clocks must show 6:00 -- do not set any clock to a different time. Draw 7 analog clocks, each reading 6:00. Add no caption or extra text.
easy_question: This picture was supposed to show a shop window or wall displaying several analog clocks. Never mind how well it is drawn, and never mind what time they show. Does the picture show several analog clocks? A photo, illustration or clean diagram all count as yes. Answer NO only if it shows a blank card, a plain panel printing an answer, or something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_item: This is a small cropped picture of a single analog clock. Look only at the SHORT hour hand -- ignore the long minute hand. Which number on the dial is the short hour hand pointing at? Answer with just that hour as a single number from 1 to 12, and nothing else.
